components.name: A2ui Compose
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Replaced the list of functions of A2uiBasicCatalogV1 with the A2uiBasicCatalogV1.Functions interface, which has a method for each basic catalog function except the logical functions and, or, and not, which the catalog implements. Implementations only need to implement openUrl and can override other methods to customize individual functions. A2uiBasicCatalogV1.Functions(context) creates default implementations of all methods. materialA2uiBasicCatalogV1 now takes functions instead of urlOpener, messageFormatter, and localeProvider. (I647b2, b/568735972)
  • Removed const from CatalogId in the companion object of A2uiBasicCatalogV1, so that the string value is not part of the public API. (I308d6, b/547851648)

Bug Fixes

  • A2uiProperty list factories now throw IllegalArgumentException if minItems or maxItems is negative, or if minItems is greater than maxItems. (Ia8a37)

components.name: Appfunctions
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • AppFunctionName has been moved from the androidx.appfunctions.metadata package to androidx.appfunctions. (Iec624)
  • Removed the default value of isDescribedByKDoc from AppFunctionDeclaration, AppFunctionSerializable and AppFunctionSignature; it must now be set explicitly. (Idcfd2)
  • Support AppFunctionServiceEntryPoint in AppFunctionTestRule (I12e01)
  • AppFunctionResourceContainer and AppFunctionTextResource are now marked as @ExperimentalAppFunctionsApi. (If9469)
  • Renamed AppFunctionAppMetadata.description to instructions, and the description XML attribute of AppFunctionAppMetadata to instructions, to align with MCP naming conventions. (I04d08)
  • Replaced regex pattern in @AppFunctionStringValueConstraint with patternMatchers backed by android.os.PatternMatcher. (I7c7cc)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed java.time parameter types failing to deserialize in apps with Java library desugaring enabled. (I211ce)
  • Fixed the issue that the generated file name could contain invalid symbol for some operating systems. (Idced4)
  • Fixed the issue that on SDK37+, the URI permissions are granted twice. (I3c845)

components.name: Camera
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Converted UseCaseCamera2Interop, ImageCaptureCamera2Interop, SessionConfigCamera2Interop, and CameraControlCamera2Interop from interfaces into abstract classes. (If654e)
  • Fixed the Camera2Interop V2 ambiguity issue (I1bbe5)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a native SIGSEGV crash on the CameraX OpenGL thread when a SurfaceProcessor released an input SurfaceTexture whose SurfaceRequest was garbage-collected before completion. (I76f73, b/563673593)
  • Fixed a Surface leak and native OpenGL crash that could occur during garbage collection when a CameraEffect's executor or HandlerThread was shut down before the effect's SurfaceOutput was closed. (Ifcc19, b/558819242)
  • Low Light Boost behavior improvement: Low Light Boost and Torch now follow a 'last setting wins' policy where enabling one automatically disables the other instead of rejecting the request. In addition, flash can now fire during image capture while Low Light Boost is active. (Ie583f)
  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Support obtaining CameraSelector on physical cameras from CameraInfo.getPhysicalCameraInfos() and binding UseCases to physical cameras. Querying CameraInfo with a physical CameraSelector now returns the physical CameraInfo instead of the logical CameraInfo. (Ibe7f2)
  • Clarified OutputOptions.Builder.setLocation Javadoc that only latitude and longitude are stored in video metadata. (I77d3b, b/551348846)
  • Fixed a bug in ImageAnalysis where changing output rotation dynamically or unbinding the use case could cause a Surface/ImageReader resource leak. (I25cef)
  • CameraInfo.getIntrinsicZoomRatio() now rounds the returned ratio to two decimal places. (Ibe9a8)
  • Relaxed HardwareBuffer.isSupported check for PRIVATE format in ImageAnalysis to prevent false negative failures on some devices. (I347a4, b/545866947)
  • Fixed a compilation crash on newer JDK versions when resolving transitively imported JSpecify type annotations on CameraX internal fields. (I00bb4, b/543937345)

components.name: Camera Viewfinder
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • compileSdk for Compose libraries updated to 37.1. This will require transitively updating compileSdk for all apps and libraries using Compose. (I05b0f)

components.name: Compose Foundation
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Modifier.border now uses a new more performant implementation. You can disable this using ComposeFoundationFlags.isNewBorderImplementationEnabled. If you run into issues and need to disable this flag, please file a bug. (I4c3b3)
  • Modifier.border now supports rendering generic / polygon shapes with a runtime shader, when using the new border implementation. (I128ca)
  • Fixes an edge case bug with rendering certain rounded rectangle outlines in Modifier.border. ComposeFoundationFlags.isRoundedRectangleBorderRenderingFixEnabled can be used to disable this change if it causes issues. (I19141)
  • Fixed an issue where the cache window incorrectly re-prefetched items when a previously prefetched item became visible. I43ca7b4

components.name: Compose Material3
components.detailsHtml:
New features

  • Added an animated shimmer effect for the component loading states.

API Changes

  • Replaced the list of functions of A2uiBasicCatalogV1 with the A2uiBasicCatalogV1.Functions interface, which has a method for each basic catalog function except the logical functions and, or, and not, which the catalog implements. Implementations only need to implement openUrl and can override other methods to customize individual functions. A2uiBasicCatalogV1.Functions(context) creates default implementations of all methods. materialA2uiBasicCatalogV1 now takes functions instead of urlOpener, messageFormatter, and localeProvider. (I647b2, b/568735972)

components.name: Compose Remote
components.detailsHtml:
New Features

  • Introduced the androidx.compose.remote:remote-creation-expression library, which will be expanded in upcoming releases with platform-agnostic expressions and remote state representations. (I4f4f2)

API Changes

  • Added RemoteTimeVariables and RemoteConfiguration objects for accessing time, animation, and display/window context variables as RemoteFloat, RemoteInt and RemoteDp. (I277c8)
  • Added currentProfileSupportsThemedColors(), currentProfileSupportsTouchModifiers(), and currentProfileSupports() to check whether the current RemoteCompose creation profile supports themed colors, touch modifiers, or specific operations. (I7b312)
  • Fixed RemoteModifier.animateEnterExit to default animationId to -1 instead of 0 so enter/exit transitions are enabled, added an optional animationId parameter, and disallowed 0 in sharedElement, sharedBounds, and animateEnterExit. (I3e5bf)
  • Decoupled RemoteDp and RemoteDensity from Compose UI Dp and TextUnit types. (Ib42cd, I31b37)
  • Removed combinedFontVariationSettings from RemoteTextStyle and added fontFeatureSettings to RemotePaint to honor Compose separation of font features and font variations. (I91856)

Bug Fixes

  • RemoteTextStyle.fromTextStyle now selects font variation settings from the font that matches the style's font weight and font style. (I2ab39)
  • Fixed pendingIntentAction not sending its PendingIntent in the embedded player and launcher widgets, and hostAction with a dynamic name losing its value. (Ic1726)
  • Fixed multi-line Center and End text alignment in CoreText. (I9867c)
  • Fixed captureSingleRemoteDocument occasionally capturing stale state written by an effect when another thread applied a snapshot concurrently. (Ib09f9)
  • Fixed nan encoded variable id comparisons in RemoteCompose expression caches. (Ibdc73)
  • Fixed TouchExpressions not responding to touch in the embedded RcPlayer. (Ida924)
  • Remote scroll containers in the embedded RcPlayer no longer pass leftover same-axis scroll to an enclosing host scroll container. (Ia193b)
  • Fixed double and long clicks in the embedded RcPlayer on components that also have a single click, and added support for touch down, up and cancel modifiers. (I7372f)
  • Fixed animated expression evaluation, document click areas, and haptic feedback in the embedded RcPlayer. (I1156e, I18831, Idfc6e)

components.name: Compose Runtime
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a memory leak in ComputedState that could the recorded values of states from being released. Also fixed an issue that could prevent ComputedState from invalidating correctly when its calculation block called Snapshot.withoutReadObservation. (I880eb)

components.name: Core
components.detailsHtml:
Bugfix release of core-1.0.1 and appcompat-1.0.2.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed bug where PrecomputedTextCompat would crash when used with RTL AppCompatTextView. b/113070424

components.name: Exifinterface
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Removing obsolete @RequiresApi(21) annotations (Ic4792)

Bug Fixes

  • Moving the default minSdk from API 21 to API 23 (Ibdfca, b/380448311, b/435705964, b/435705223)
  • Fixed isSupportedMimeType to match existing parsing support for HEIC and AVIF (supported on API 28+ and 31+ respectively).

components.name: Glance Wear
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added GlanceWearProfiles.wearWidgets RemoteCompose profile for Glance Wear widgets and their supported operations. (I84225)

components.name: Ink
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Add anti-aliasing to cut edges of strokes edited with the partial stroke eraser (Stroke.subtract, optionally followed by Stroke.split)

components.name: Lifecycle
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • SavedStateHandle now provides functions to integrate with SavedStateContainer. There is asContainer() to transform the SavedStateHandle as a SavedStateContainer, getOrCreateContainer() to make a child container inside of the handle, and getOrCreateSavedStateHandle() which creates a child SavedStateHandle inside of the current one. As part of the move to SavedStateContainer, it is also no longer valid to use getStateFlow and getLiveData together on a SavedStateHandle and doing so will throw an IllegalArgumentException (I62f36)

components.name: Media3
components.detailsHtml:
• Common Library:
    • Add C.COLOR_SPACE_DISPLAY_P3 and support Display P3 color space in MediaFormatUtil and ColorInfo ISO color mappings.
    • Add a central Flags registry to manage experimental feature flags and staged rollout (Flags.setCanaryModeEnabled). Migrated many existing @ExperimentalApi methods to use the new flags API.
    • Add MediaMetadata.playlistId, MediaMetadata.Builder.setPlaylistId(String), MediaMetadata.categories, and MediaMetadata.Builder.setCategories(List<String>).
    • Replace androidx.media3.common.util.NonNullApi with JSpecify org.jspecify.annotations.NullMarked.
  • ExoPlayer:
    • Fix an issue where DASH multi-period playback gets stuck when the next period's first chunk fails to load (#3396).
    • Report wasCanceled = true in AnalyticsListener.onLoadError and MediaSourceEventListener.onLoadError when load retries are exhausted.
    • Support registering multiple VideoFrameMetadataListener instances using ExoPlayer.addVideoFrameMetadataListener and ExoPlayer.removeVideoFrameMetadataListener, deprecating ExoPlayer.setVideoFrameMetadataListener and ExoPlayer.clearVideoFrameMetadataListener.
    • Add support for ads in multi-period content (e.g., DASH) by splitting and offsetting the AdPlaybackState for each period.
    • Fix race condition in PreCacheHelper where canceling an ongoing preparation request could still start background downloads.
    • Limit setLoadOnlySelectedTracks(true) on ProgressiveMediaSource and DefaultMediaSourceFactory to only filter out unselected video and image tracks. Audio and text tracks are always loaded to allow seamless track switching without re-buffering.
    • Enable setLoadOnlySelectedTracks(true) by default on ProgressiveMediaSource and DefaultMediaSourceFactory. This saves memory and allows DefaultLoadControl buffer allocation calculations to work more accurately when not all tracks are selected. Note that this may cause additional buffering if unselected video or image tracks are newly enabled mid-playback.
    • Fix an issue where Player.getCurrentPosition() could return stale values (updating only a few times per second) when dynamic scheduling is enabled (#3286).
    • Fix an issue where an unexpected decrease or reset in the AudioTrack playback head position could be incorrectly treated as an integer overflow, causing playback to stall in buffering (#3407).
    • Remove experimental DefaultMediaCodecAdapterFactory.setAsyncCryptoSynchronizationEnabled(boolean).
    • Avoid unnecessary renderer re-enables and glitches when returning from interstitials or ads into content clipped at the end (#3371).
    • Fix an issue where a renderer error on an upcoming playlist item could prematurely interrupt current playback when Flags.FLAG_PER_STREAM_MEDIA_PROGRESSION is enabled.
    • Fix a NullPointerException that could occur if ExoPlayer transitioned renderers to an unprepared media period when Flags.FLAG_PER_STREAM_MEDIA_PROGRESSION is enabled.
    • Fix an issue where video frames could be unexpectedly skipped or dropped during dynamic scheduling when Flags.FLAG_VIDEO_RENDERER_DURATION_TO_PROGRESS is enabled.
    • Fix an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in analytics listeners when stopping playback during an ad on a livestream (#3423).
    • Fix an issue where PreloadMediaSource could unexpectedly post preload event when preload() is never called (#3408).
    • Fix an issue where Format.subsampleOffsetUs was ignored for metadata tracks, causing incorrect playback timestamps in decoded SCTE-35 splice commands (#3413).
    • Fix a memory leak in PreloadMediaSource and DefaultPreloadManager when preload() is called multiple times on the same source (#3445).
    • Fix a NullPointerException when releasing AdsMediaSource while a content timeline refresh is pending (#3442).
    • Fix an issue where playback of progressive media could jump to the wrong position when a load after a seek (or when starting playback at a non-zero position) failed and was retried (#3440).
    • Add workaround for the Xiaomi TV Stick 4K (MiTV-AYFR0) H.264 decoder freezing on seamless resolution changes (#3457).
    • Fix a NullPointerException in SteeringManifestTracker when the tracker is stopped before a posted load completion or error callback is executed (#3443).
    • Support HAGC (ST 2094-50) timed metadata playback from mebx boxed metadata tracks in MP4 files.
    • Fix an issue where slow-preparing media periods in a playlist could be skipped.
  • CompositionPlayer:
    • Support configuring the frame rate of video frame aggregation using Composition.Builder.setVideoFrameAggregationParameters for playback workflows.
    • Fix frame drops in multi-sequence compositions caused by timestamp quantization or rounding mismatches, by selecting the frame with the closest timestamp during frame aggregation. This is enabled from API 29 only, as it requires holding one additional frame in flight per video sequence.
  • Transformer:
    • Support configuring the frame rate of video frame aggregation using Composition.Builder.setVideoFrameAggregationParameters for export workflows.
    • Fix frame drops in multi-sequence compositions caused by timestamp quantization or rounding mismatches, by selecting the frame with the closest timestamp during frame aggregation. This is enabled from API 29 only, as it requires holding one additional frame in flight per video sequence.
    • Respect Transformer#setAudioMimeType(AUDIO_RAW) when AudioProcessors are used. Prior to this fix, requesting MimeTypes.AUDIO_RAW and applying an AudioProcessor resulted in compressed output.
  • Track Selection:
    • Fix an issue where an SDR track was incorrectly preferred over a supported Dolby Vision track on some devices (#3135).
  • Extractors:
    • Mp4Extractor: Fix dOps box parsing for Opus in MP4 where PreSkip, InputSampleRate, and OutputGain were not converted from big-endian to little-endian, causing the first ~299 ms of audio to be dropped when no edit list is present (#3431).
    • Remove Mp4Extractor.FLAG_READ_WITHIN_GOP_SAMPLE_DEPENDENCIES, Mp4Extractor.FLAG_READ_WITHIN_GOP_SAMPLE_DEPENDENCIES_H265, FragmentedMp4Extractor.FLAG_READ_WITHIN_GOP_SAMPLE_DEPENDENCIES, and FragmentedMp4Extractor.FLAG_READ_WITHIN_GOP_SAMPLE_DEPENDENCIES_H265 as within-GOP sample dependency parsing for H.264 and H.265 is enabled by default.
    • Mp4Extractor: Fix location metadata parsing from xyz boxes containing altitude coordinates to populate Mp4LocationData.
    • Add ExtractorUtil.getFramesPerEncodedSample to calculate the number of audio frames per sample for encoded audio formats (#3367).
    • Add FLAG_READ_XMP_METADATA to Mp4Extractor to extract XMP metadata from top-level UUID boxes.
    • Fix corrupted AC-3, DTS and LPCM audio when playing DVD-style MPEG-PS content, by stripping the private_stream_1 sub-stream header from each PES packet in PsExtractor before the payload is passed to the audio reader (#3327).
    • Fix failure in FragmentedMp4Extractor when a version 1 tfdt box encodes a negative baseMediaDecodeTime (#3412).
    • MPEG-TS: Support parsing H.264 and H.265 frame packing arrangement SEI messages to populate Format.stereoMode (#3419).
    • Parse Dolby Vision Profile 20 configuration data and reject unsupported Dolby Vision profiles instead of playing back as standard HEVC with incorrect colors (#3427).
    • MP3: Revert LAME/Xing encoder delay & padding metadata adjustment because it's incompatible with many MediaCodec MP3 decoders (#3425).
    • Matroska: Fix NullPointerException when parsing nested ChapterAtom elements (#3438).
    • Ogg: Fix bug where a packet whose size is a multiple of 255 bytes and ends at a page boundary is merged with the following packet.
    • MP4: Parse mebx boxed timed metadata tracks in Mp4Extractor and FragmentedMp4Extractor. Tracks carrying an it35 key are exposed as MimeTypes.APPLICATION_ITUT_T35 (enabling HAGC playback). Other mebx tracks are ignored unless FLAG_EMIT_RAW_MEBX_DATA is set, in which case all mebx tracks are emitted as raw MimeTypes.APPLICATION_MEBX.
    • Ogg: Support extracting Opus end-padding for gapless playback (#2576), and fix sample timestamps after seeking to a page that starts with a continued packet.
    • Ogg: Fix decode errors and ~1s timestamp jumps in chained Ogg Opus streams by ignoring mid-stream Opus ID and comment header packets.
  • Inspector:
    • Support retrieving XMP metadata from MP4 files using MetadataRetriever.
    • Support extracting mebx boxed timed metadata tracks in MediaExtractorCompat as MimeTypes.APPLICATION_MEBX.
  • Inspector Frame:
    • Fix clipping of wide-gamut BT.2020 colors in the SDR base image when extracting Ultra HDR frames with FrameExtractor. Out-of-gamut colors are now softly compressed into the sRGB gamut instead of being clamped.
  • Audio:
    • Add workaround for devices that invoke android.media.AudioDeviceCallback on the wrong thread (#3386).
    • Fix potential stuck playbacks after track transitions with compressed offload.
    • Work around an issue on Amazon Fire TV sticks where AC-3 audio could freeze during period transitions (#3448).
    • Support trimming end-of-stream encoder padding for Ogg and WebM/Matroska Opus gapless playback (#2576).
    • Fix dynamic offload gapless delay and padding updates during track transitions so they apply to the incoming track rather than the playing track.
    • Trim encoder end-padding on single streams and the final stream in a playlist in addition to mid-playlist gapless transitions (#2576).
    • Avoid unnecessary audio buffer copies in TrimmingAudioProcessor after start-of-stream encoder delay trimming has completed and no end-of-stream padding needs to be trimmed.
  • Video:
    • Fix reporting of late video frames with identical release timestamps so that they are reported as dropped instead of skipped.
  • Text:
    • Add MediaItem.SubtitleConfiguration.timeOffsetUs to shift the timestamps of sideloaded subtitles relative to the media. The offset can be changed during playback with Player.replaceMediaItem(int, MediaItem) without interrupting playback (#1976).
    • SubRip: Add support for injecting a CharsetDetector into DefaultSubtitleParserFactory to detect the character encoding of standalone SubRip subtitles without a byte order mark (#2247).
  • Effect:
    • Implement SoundSeparationAudioProcessor for audio source separation using StudioSound GMSCore module.
  • Muxers:
    • Fix dOps box writing for Opus in Mp4Muxer and FragmentedMp4Muxer where PreSkip, InputSampleRate, and OutputGain were written in little-endian instead of big-endian (#3431).
    • Support writing GPS altitude in Mp4LocationData using Mp4Muxer.
    • Add Muxer.Factory.create(ParcelFileDescriptor) to allow muxing directly to a ParcelFileDescriptor.
    • Write tfdt (Track Fragment Base Media Decode Time) box by default in traf boxes of fragmented MP4 files to provide media decode timestamps.
    • Support writing E-AC-3 and E-AC-3 JOC (Dolby Atmos) dec3 container boxes in Mp4Muxer.
    • Add WebM format support to MediaMuxerCompat.
    • Write mfra (Movie Fragment Random Access) box at the end of fragmented MP4 files to allow seeking in FragmentedMp4Extractor using FLAG_READ_MFRA_FOR_SEEK_MAP.
    • Fix crash in Mp4Writer and FragmentedMp4Writer when writing an EOS sample before any other samples are written.
    • Fix container compliance when muxing Dolby content into MP4 or Fragmented MP4 files by advertising the dby1 compatible brand in the container header (#3369).
    • Support 32-bit float PCM audio tracks in Mp4Muxer and FragmentedMp4Muxer (#3389).
    • Reject unsupported Dolby Vision profiles in Mp4Muxer and FragmentedMp4Muxer when adding tracks.
    • Support 24-bit and 32-bit integer PCM audio tracks in Mp4Muxer and FragmentedMp4Muxer.
  • IMA extension:
    • Forward player pause and resume events to the IMA SDK in ImaServerSideAdInsertionMediaSource.
  • Session:
    • Add MediaConstants.EXTRAS_KEY_PLAYLIST_ID, MediaConstants.EXTRAS_KEY_PLAYLIST_TITLE, MediaConstants.EXTRAS_KEY_PLAYLIST_ARTWORK_URI, and MediaConstants.EXTRAS_KEY_CATEGORIES to populate playlist and item metadata from legacy metadata and descriptions, and MediaConstants.EXTRAS_KEY_SUGGESTED_TYPE and MediaConstants.EXTRAS_KEY_TTL_SECONDS for suggestion LibraryParams.extras.
    • Fix SecurityException crash when creating or releasing a MediaSession on devices that enforce strict PendingIntent limits.
    • Fix issue where MediaSession.getControllerForCurrentRequest() returned null during play requests on Android 12 (API 31 and 32) when MediaSessionService was not yet in the foreground.
    • Fix IllegalArgumentException crash when a MediaController connects to a legacy session that reports a negative maximum volume.
    • Fix an issue where calling MediaController.setMediaItem or setMediaItems followed by play() on a paused legacy MediaSessionCompat could dispatch an unsupported onPrepareFrom* callback instead of onPlayFrom*, or dispatch onPlay() without re-initializing the requested media item.
    • Fix NullPointerException in legacy MediaBrowser when receiving a custom command response (#3432).
    • Fix IllegalArgumentException crash when receiving legacy metadata with duplicate keys in its underlying Bundle.
    • Coalesce outgoing MediaControllerCompat.TransportControls calls made within the same Looper iteration when controlling a legacy MediaSessionCompat (for example, calling setMediaItem, prepare, and play together now dispatches a single onPlayFrom* callback).
  • UI:
    • Fix RTL subtitle punctuation positioning and span range preservation when bidirectional text wrapping is enabled (#3454, #3455).
    • Add TrackSelectionState and TrackSelectionParametersState classes and their corresponding Composable state remember functions to the media3-ui-compose module.
    • Introduce PresentationState.videoAspectRatio and make Modifier.resizeWithContentScale take aspectRatio: Float? instead of sourceSizeDp: Size?.
    • Add CuesState class and rememberCuesState Composable to the media3-ui-compose module for listening to player's current cues.
    • Add scrubbing mode support to ProgressSlider if it is based on ExoPlayer or CompositionPlayer.
    • Add showArtwork support to PresentationState and use it to time rendering of the provided optional artwork Composable in ContentFrame and Player. Add Artwork Composable to be used as the default value for the artwork slot.
    • Add new fields to PlayPauseButtonState (showBuffering, showRetry, showReplay) and use them in PlayPauseButton to render more icons and a buffering indicator.
    • Add PlaybackState class to allow custom playback state observation, and introduce BufferingIndicator as a button-independent component.
    • Fix an issue where PlayerView and PlayerControlView showed ad markers at period boundaries for live postroll placeholders in multi-period livestreams.
    • Composable slots of Player, ContentFrame, PlayerDefaults and MiniController no longer receive the player or the controls visibility as parameters. Capture them from the calling scope instead (for example, topControls is now @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit). This is a breaking change on an unstable API.
    • Add alignment parameter to ContentFrame, Player and Modifier.resizeWithContentScale to position the scaled content within its container, and clip the content of ContentFrame to its bounds, so that video scaled with ContentScale.Crop no longer draws outside it.
    • Add livestream UI support to ProgressSlider, ProgressStateWithTickCount and ProgressStateWithTickInterval by exposing isLive and liveOffsetMs. Add LiveButton Composable to media3-ui-compose-material3 (#2213).
  • Ktor extension:
    • Fix an issue where KtorDataSource could treat mid-stream connection failures as end-of-input instead of throwing an HttpDataSourceException (#3460).
  • HLS extension:
    • Parse VIDEO-RANGE (PQ and HLG) on EXT-X-STREAM-INF and EXT-X-I-FRAME-STREAM-INF into Format.colorInfo (#3441).
    • Fix NullPointerException when parsing MPEG-TS EXT-X-MAP initialization segments that contain PES media samples (#3456).
    • Fix regression where Format.id and Format.metadata were null for exposed HLS tracks (#3402).
    • Clip asset-list ads to X-PLAYOUT-LIMIT and skip those that fall entirely past the limit, and default the content resume offset to 0 when an interstitial omits X-RESUME-OFFSET and its duration is unknown even if X-PLAYOUT-LIMIT is set.
    • Fix an issue where resolving an X-ASSET-LIST interstitial overwrote the content resume offset contributions of other interstitials in the same ad group.
  • DASH extension:
    • Support parsing Alternative MPD Insertion (urn:mpeg:dash:event:alternativeMPD:insert:2025) and Replacement (urn:mpeg:dash:event:alternativeMPD:replace:2025) events in DashManifestParser and expose them as AlternativeMpdEvent instances in Period.alternativeMpdEvents. This is a breaking change for apps that subclass DashManifestParser: DashManifestParser.buildPeriod now takes an additional List<AlternativeMpdEvent> parameter and the previous overload has been removed. Apps overriding DashManifestParser.parseEventStream(XmlPullParser) must override DashManifestParser.parseEventStream(XmlPullParser, String) instead, as the former is deprecated and will be made private in a future release.
    • Parse CICP color information (ColourPrimaries, TransferCharacteristics, MatrixCoefficients, and VideoFullRangeFlag) from EssentialProperty and SupplementalProperty descriptors into Format.colorInfo (#3426).
    • Support whitespace-separated lists of @id values in trick mode (http://dashif.org/guidelines/trickmode) descriptor @value attributes (#3315).
    • Support parsing <ProducerReferenceTime> in DashManifestParser, exposing it in AdaptationSet.producerReferenceTimes, and using it to populate Timeline.Window.presentationStartTimeMs and Timeline.Window.windowStartTimeMs for VOD streams.
    • Add support for DASH Content Steering (#1689).
    • Fix a NullPointerException that could occur when parsing a DASH manifest with a missing attribute in <UTCTiming> element (#3436).
  • RTSP extension:
    • Fix an IllegalStateException crash that occurred when processing delayed network responses after the RTSP client was closed.
    • Fix issue where rapid scrubbing could incorrectly trigger the TCP protocol fallback mechanic.
    • Fix an IllegalStateException crash that can occur when processing delayed network responses after the RTSP client resets state during track reselection, session teardown, or uri redirection.
    • Fix issue where seeking again prior to playback restart could cause an IllegalStateException crash.
    • Fix issue where seeking backward while a seek is already pending could cause audio dropout and video playback freeze.
    • Fix an issue where H.264 and H.265 keyframe access units ending with an aggregation or non-IDR packet were not flagged as keyframes, causing playback to remain stuck in buffering (#3434).
  • Decoder extensions (FFmpeg, VP9, AV1, etc.):
    • Opus extension: Fix JNI crash when decoding invalid Opus data.
    • Opus extension: Fix discard padding being ignored when pre-skip and discard padding fall on the same packet (#2576).
  • Cast extension:
    • Introduce SessionAvailabilityListener.SessionUnavailableReason to represent the reason for session unavailability, and provide an overloaded method for SessionAvailabilityListener.onCastSessionUnavailable to expose it.
    • Fix an issue where playback would unexpectedly resume locally after stopping a Cast session.
    • Log an error when RemoteMediaClient operations (such as play, pause, speed change, repeat mode, volume, mute, or track selection) fail in RemoteCastPlayer (#3373).
    • Fix ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in RemoteCastPlayer when the Cast receiver queue changes or shrinks while a seek operation is pending (#3372).
    • Fix an issue with the default Cast receiver where the timeline only populated media items immediately surrounding the active item rather than the entire playlist (#3129).
    • Update the timeline and playback position immediately when modifying the playlist (setMediaItems, addMediaItems, moveMediaItems, removeMediaItems) or seeking in RemoteCastPlayer, and queue successive playlist operations so they execute reliably in order (#2639, #3272).
    • Fix an issue where calling addMediaItems on an empty queue in RemoteCastPlayer failed to load the media items on the Cast receiver (#2402).
    • Fix an issue in RemoteCastPlayer where reaching the end of the Cast receiver queue cleared the timeline instead of retaining the playlist.
    • Fix an issue where playWhenReady, repeatMode, and playbackParameters were not transferred or applied when set on RemoteCastPlayer before loading media items (for example, during local-to-remote playback transfer in CastPlayer) (#889).
  • Demo app:
    • Add support for DRM-protected media items and an additional HLS sample stream to the session demo app catalog.
    • Configure RemoteCastPlayer with a CastTrackSelector in the session demo app to enable subtitle and audio track selection while casting.
  • Remove deprecated symbols:
    • Remove DashUtil.buildDataSpec(Representation, RangedUri, int) and DashUtil.buildDataSpec(Representation, String, RangedUri, int). Use DashUtil.buildDataSpec(Representation, BaseUrl, RangedUri, int, Map<String, String>) instead.
  • Build:
    • Increase Gradle minSdk to 24.

Important changes since 1.0.0:

components.name: Photopicker
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added EXTRA_SYSTEM_FALLBACK_PICK_IMAGES_REQUEST_LOCATION_METADATA_ACCESS to PickVisualMedia to allow requesting location metadata access in system fallback pickers. (Ie5917)
  • Renamed artifact androidx.photopicker:photopicker to androidx.photopicker:photopicker-embedded (package androidx.photopicker.embedded), androidx.photopicker:photopicker-compose to androidx.photopicker:photopicker-embedded-compose (package androidx.photopicker.embedded.compose), and androidx.photopicker:photopicker-testing to androidx.photopicker:photopicker-embedded-testing (package androidx.photopicker.embedded.testing). (I48b9b, b/537430760)
  • Refactored EmbeddedPhotoPickerState to expose surfacePackage and notifyVisibilityChanged and added and onError callback. (Ifa4b0)
  • Added setLocationMetadataAccessRequested to PickVisualMediaRequest to allow requesting location metadata access in Photo Picker requests. (Idde80)
  • Migrated PickVisualMedia and PickMultipleVisualMedia contracts, and PickVisualMediaRequest to the new photopicker-activity artifact. Copied tests. (I2a201, b/530216959)
  • Removed the inputs parameter from rememberEmbeddedPhotoPickerState. To reset the state when inputs change, wrap the call in a key block instead. (I8a0c5)
  • Lowered the minSdk of the androidx.photopicker:photopicker and androidx.photopicker:photopicker-compose libraries to 23. (I94e42, b/524083018)
  • Revising Embedded PhotoPicker Compose APIs (Ie32c9)
  • New libraries for Photopicker (I0f52a)
  • New testing library for photopicker (I7c1ec)

Bug Fixes

  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • compileSdk for Compose libraries updated to 37.1. This will require transitively updating compileSdk for all apps and libraries using Compose. (I05b0f)
  • Updated Compose compileSdk to API 37. This means that a minimum AGP version of 9.2.0 is required when using Compose. (Id45cd)

components.name: Room3
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added setPreparedStatementCacheSize(maxCacheSize: Int) to RoomDatabase.Builder on Android to allow configuring or disabling the per-connection prepared statement cache. (I7b0cb, b/560123297)
  • Added allowDataLossOnRecovery() to RoomDatabase.Builder to allow recovering from database opening and corruption failures. (Ie86ba, b/316945228)
  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)
  • Fixed an issue where DAO queries with @Relation and non-deterministic clauses (such as ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT :count) re-executed the query on statement reset, causing relationship mapping failures. (Id0992, b/413924560)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed fully expanded transitive type aliases in KSP by recursively resolving type aliases and properly resetting type arguments. (I8228d0, b/561698196)

components.name: Savedstate
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Introduced a new SavedStateContainer API to serve as the common implementation base for SaveableStateRegistry, SavedStateHandle, and SavedStateRegisty. (I1da6d)
  • Added asContainer(), getOrCreateContainer() to SavedStateRegistry to allow creating child contains from a SavedStateRegistry. (Icb709)

components.name: Sqlite
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)

components.name: Test Backup
components.detailsHtml:
New Features

  • Simplified test setup in Android Gradle Plugin backup test suites by automatically targeting the tested app when @BackupRestoreConfig is omitted. (I1452b)
  • Added support for inheriting @BackupRestoreConfig and @Isolation settings from an outer test class in @Nested test classes. (Ia45a8)
  • Added support for injecting BackupRestoreController directly into test class constructors and @BeforeAll setup methods. (I6e822, Ia2ebd)
  • Added support for pinning a specific device to a @Device role in multi-device tests using the androidx.test.backup.device.serial.{role} property. (I484be)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed performBackup and performRestore so tests fail immediately instead of passing silently when a backup is skipped or empty, when the backup service errors out, or when a local backup archive belongs to a different app or device. (I7673d, I478ad, I0b989, I9a0ea, I79567)
  • Fixed tests hanging indefinitely on unresponsive devices by enforcing timeouts across backup, restore, device actions, and cleanup steps. (I10661, I9cdee, If5f92)
  • Fixed performBackup deleting generated backup files when the test run finished, so backup archives are now kept on disk after tests exit. (I8c13f)
  • Fixed database test helpers (StorageDomain.Database) to properly store and check null values, overwrite existing rows when seeding test data, catch invalid table configurations early, and fail when an expected database file is missing. (Ib4767, Iddf87, I19c43, Ie8d78, I8bc18)
  • Fixed SharedPreferences test helpers to preserve data types accurately and support checking for null or removed preferences. (I8456d9, I1d0fc2)
  • Fixed runOnDevice to handle large test payloads without crashing, pause for the debugger when waitForDebugger is enabled, find the test runner in custom test APK package names, and block internal runner flags from leaking into device actions. (Ic73bd, Iede17, I1d172, I84c15)
  • Improved test stability and speed by sharing a single ADB connection across the test run, installing APKs only once per device, and failing clearly when an APK fails to install or launch. (I62717, Iabf75, I14e6f, I4c3da5, I54077, Iee84e)
  • Fixed fetchDeviceLogs writing empty log files, and stopped cancelled test runs from generating false failure reports. (I736c4, I7b199, Ia847e)
  • Cleaned up backup-host dependencies so adblib is available directly to callers and internal logging or test libraries no longer clash with your project's classpath. (I6e822, Iba9a4, Ib4ec9)

Version 1.0.0-alpha02

October 07, 2026

androidx.test.backup:backup:1.0.0-alpha02 and androidx.test.backup:backup-host:1.0.0-alpha02 are released. Version 1.0.0-alpha02 contains these commits.

API Changes

  • Payload keys are now documented as BackupActionInputKeys, BackupActionOutputKeys, and BackupActionValues, replacing the constants on BackupDeviceAction. Added BackupDeviceActionResult.success() and failure() factories, along with isSuccess and errorMessage accessors. (Ibd493)

Bug Fixes

  • BackupRestoreController.clearAppData now throws IOException when pm clear does not report success, instead of continuing silently. (I61556)
  • Shell arguments passed to BackupRestoreController for device execution are now correctly escaped to prevent command injection and ensure file paths with spaces are handled securely.
  • Hardened the bundled storage actions (PopulateStorageAction and AssertStorageAction) against silent verification passes to ensure tests strictly fail when expected data is missing.
  • Host-side test orchestrators now correctly honor in-band action failures reported by the device instead of ignoring them.
  • Fixed an issue with database row population by percent-encoding the database 'values' wire format, preventing data corruption during payload transport.
  • Addressed security vulnerabilities in androidx.test.backup:backup-host by upgrading dependencies.

components.name: Text
components.detailsHtml:
Note: This is intended to be the last beta release.

New Features

  • Added a "Subtitle Cue" tab to VerticalTextSampleActivity to demonstrate VerticalText capabilities, including rendering with wrapped height, toVerticalTextStyle(), RubySpan, EmphasisSpan, Tate-chu-yoko, FontShearSpan, UnderlineSpan, and StrikethroughSpan. I4799d1 b/571750156

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed horizontal RubySpan and EmphasisSpan line height when using fonts with large top and bottom padding such as Noto Sans JP. (Ib0507, b/557316470) - Thanks for the report, Numero-san!
  • Updated Compose dependencies to 1.12.1. (I9ee7f, b/569780191)
  • VerticalText now applies AnnotatedString span styles and preserves AnnotatedString spans and annotations in semantics. (Ib077f, b/502088091)
  • Fixed RubySpan and EmphasisSpan not filling the background color of TextPaint.bgColor or BackgroundColorSpan in horizontal layout. (I66ba8, b/561269843)
  • Fixed background colors in vertical text that were drawn as outlines after a span set Paint.Style.STROKE. (I692ed, b/566429122)
  • CharacterStyle spans that cover a full RubySpan range in VerticalTextLayout now also apply to the ruby text, and RubySpan.textScale scales the font sizes that they set. Background colors now also fill the empty space above and below the shorter of the ruby text and the base text. (I0dadc, b/564268825)
  • Fixed VerticalTextLayout background height when upright text has multiple style runs. (I7e31a, b/565211671)
  • Fixed VerticalText retaining a stale background color when VerticalTextStyle.background changes to Color.Unspecified. (Ia0861, b/565211671)
  • Fixed horizontal ruby and emphasis layouts skipping TextPaint fields when copying the caller paint. (Ia3043, b/561269843)
  • VerticalText now draws the background color from VerticalTextStyle.background behind plain String text and behind plain String ruby annotations in RubySpan. (If0493, b/564268825)
  • Fixed horizontal ruby layout leaving the shared working paint scaled after initialization. (I33760, b/561269843)
  • Fixed the vertical text sample app so that a pan gesture cannot move the text out of view. (If0108, b/563461635)
  • Fixed the test app to demo emphasis mark position (I3ffa3, b/559972132)
  • Added Kex symbolic execution branch tests for LineLayout, TextUtils, CanvasCompat, and PaintCompat. I47edf b/569212211

Version 1.0.0-beta02

September 23, 2026

androidx.text:text-vertical:1.0.0-beta02 and androidx.text:text-vertical-compose:1.0.0-beta02 are released. Version 1.0.0-beta02 contains these commits.

Important Changes

  • We have added test cases to ensure backward compatibility down to API 24 (Android 7.0), and the results have been highly positive!
  • The libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)
  • The vertical text libraries now compile against SDK 37. Apps that use them must compile against SDK 37 and use AGP 9.1.0 or later. (I0f757, b/562182206)

Bug Fixes

  • EmphasisSpan.position now moves the emphasis mark. AnnotationPosition.Before puts the mark above horizontal text and right of vertical text. AnnotationPosition.After puts it on the opposite side. (Ic9bfd, b/559972132)
  • Fixed the emphasis mark scale in horizontal text layout. The reserved line height no longer assumes an unscaled mark. (I6d7fe, b/562254557)
  • Fixed the backport for vertical text advances. The backport ignored the requested offset on API levels less than 34. (I8877a, b/495457561)
  • Fixed horizontal ruby text reserving too much vertical space on API levels below 28, which could leave a line taller than necessary. (Iceb60, b/561323466)
  • The tests for vertical ruby and text orientation now run on all supported API levels. (If07d4, b/495457561)
  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I7264b, b/556807521)
  • Fixed RubySpan.position being ignored in horizontal text layout. AnnotationPosition.After now correctly renders ruby text below the base text. (Iaffa1, b/559972124, b/561323466)
  • Fixed RubySpan.position being ignored in vertical text layout. AnnotationPosition.After now correctly renders ruby text on the left side of the base text. (I0be1c, b/495457561)
  • Upgrade Compose dependencies to 1.11.4 (I9ef07, b/536925341)

Version 1.0.0-beta01

August 26, 2026

androidx.text:text-vertical:1.0.0-beta01 and androidx.text:text-vertical-compose:1.0.0-beta01 are released. Version 1.0.0-beta01 contains these commits.

API Changes

  • Changed VerticalTextScope from an interface to a concrete class. (I44e71, b/549288808)

Bug Fixes

  • Updated documentation for combineUpright. (Ib534b, b/548992014)
  • Removed incorrect API 36 minimum requirement documentation from VerticalText. (I4f8e9, b/549288799)
  • Used calculated ascent ratio for vertical baseline offset in backport mode (07339d7, b/502088091)

Version 1.0.0-alpha06

July 29, 2026

androidx.text:text-vertical:1.0.0-alpha06 and androidx.text:text-vertical-compose:1.0.0-alpha06 are released. Version 1.0.0-alpha06 contains these commits.

Important Changes

  • This release marks the final planned alpha version of the library.
  • Finalized and refined the parameters in the VerticalText composable

API Changes

  • Introduced VerticalTextStyle for vertical text layout. (I647a8, b/512424512)
  • Introduced a new public DSL (VerticalTextScope and buildVerticalText) in the text-vertical-compose library (I6faa7, b/502088091)
  • Introduce VerticalText composable (I96509, b/502088091)

Bug Fixes

  • Clarified documentation for VerticalTextLayout fallback behavior on older API levels. (Ia7ccc, b/449184326)

There are no release notes for this artifact.

components.name: Tracing
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a race condition in the pool management where the same thread could concurrently flush and release packets, which caused potential deadlocks especially when using an EmptyCoroutineContext. (Ia0aef48c, b/570135466)

components.name: Wear Compose
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Renamed PullToRefreshDefaults.indicatorShape to IndicatorShape and changed PullToRefreshState to an interface. (I95b98)
  • Added showIndicatorDelayMillis parameter to Modifier.oneHandedGesture to customize the delay before onGestureAvailable is invoked. Defaults to OneHandedGestureDefaults.ShowIndicatorDelayMillis (1 second). (I38cc7)
  • Added StatusBarSuppression overload with a content lambda to allow wrapping ScreenScaffold and suppressing the System Status Bar top-down while automatically resetting top content padding to 0.dp. (I18ff9)
  • Added a discrete integer steps overload and showMinimumSegment parameter to Material 3 Slider. (Idce23)
  • Removed experimental feature flag WearComposeFoundationFlags.isWarpingCurvedTextEnabled. Warped curved text is now always enabled by default. (Ifc5c2)
  • Removed experimental feature flag WearComposeMaterial3Flags.isSwipeToRevealDualFlingThresholdEnabled. The dual fling threshold behavior in SwipeToReveal is now always enabled. (Ia8036)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a 1-frame visual glitch where TimeText would momentarily appear when entering composition on an already scrolled-down list. (Id13da)
  • Fixed an issue where ScreenScaffold ScrollIndicator would not reappear on scroll after idling when used without an enclosing AppScaffold. (I445e5)
  • Fixed an issue where PullToRefreshBox indicator remained stuck on screen when onRefresh did not transition isRefreshing to true. (I097e2)
  • Added PullToRefresh to Wear Compose Material 3 baseline profile. (Ib8e13)
  • Update PredictiveBackScene to switch LocalScreenIsActive.current to the target screen on navigation instantly. (I3904b)
  • Fixed an issue in TransformingLazyColumn ScrollInfoProvider where anchorItemOffset failed to reset to zero when content padding shrank while scrolled. (I779a0)
  • Fixed TransformingLazyColumnState.animateScrollToItem to smoothly center the target item without a final jump when items use transformedHeight. (I429c8)
  • Fixed an issue in ScalingLazyColumn ScrollInfoProvider where anchorItemOffset failed to reset to zero when content padding shrank while scrolled. (Ie8b06)
  • Fixed TransformingLazyColumn animation issues by disabling animations during raw scroll passes. (Iacfb4)
  • Added AndroidManifest.xml file for Wear Compose Material3, which configures the com.google.wear.ENABLE_GLOBAL_STATUS_BAR meta-data tag(Ic8804)

components.name: Wear Compose Remote
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added dynamicRemoteColorScheme() to create a RemoteColorScheme whose colors follow the player's Android system (dynamic) colors. (I35bf5)
  • RemoteIntroOutroCurvedProgressIndicator replaces the RemoteCurvedProgressIndicator overload that took totalTimerDurationMillis. Its intro and outro animations play when the progress leaves its start and once it reaches its end, so it works for goals as well as timers. (I96317)
  • Added RemoteMotionScheme and RemoteMaterialTheme.motionScheme to Remote Wear Material3, matching Wear Compose Material 3 MotionScheme. (I9bd93)
  • Remove combinedFontVariationSettings from RemoteTextStyle to honor Compose separation of font features and font variations. (I91856)

Bug Fixes

  • RemoteTextStyle.fromTextStyle now selects font variation settings from the font that matches the style's font weight and font style. (I2ab39)
  • Added RemoteSegmentedCircularProgressIndicator to Remote Wear Material3. (I814b7)
  • Added RemoteTextToggleButton to Remote Wear Material3. (Ie5d96)
  • Added RemoteIconToggleButton to Remote Wear Material3. (I825b2)
  • Fixed RemoteCurvedProgressIndicator losing its gap at low progress when dotCollapsible = false. (Iac3d2)
  • Fixed RemoteSplitCheckboxButton, RemoteSplitRadioButton, and RemoteSplitSwitchButton outer corners appearing square on renderers that do not apply the outer rounded clip. (I59e93)
  • RemoteTypography now preserves font variation settings from the font that matches each style's font weight and font style alongside fontFeatureSettings. (I2ab39)

components.name: Webkit
components.detailsHtml:
Important changes since 1.17.0:

  • Cross-Origin Isolation Management: Introduces new profile-level APIs (Profile#setCrossOriginIsolatedAllowlist and getCrossOriginIsolatedAllowlist) to allow the use of SharedArrayBuffer and other APIs that require cross-origin isolation. Web pages must also opt in by setting the Document-Isolation-Policy header as appropriate. When this feature is used, origins on the allowlist will be permitted to use these APIs despite not being fully cross-origin isolated. Care must be taken to only allowlist trusted origins.
  • Prefetch Queue Draining Control: Adds a new WEBVIEW_NAVIGATE_DRAIN_PREFETCH constant to WebViewFeature which can be used to determine whether Navigation#navigate will drain the prefetch queue before navigating to the new URL.
  • API Modernization & Cleanups: Includes several method renames for clarity. PrefetchParameters#isJavaScriptEnabled has been renamed to includeClientHints, with the older method now marked as deprecated, and isJavaScriptEnabled marked as deprecated. Additionally, Profile#addQuicHints has been renamed to preferQuicFor.

components.name: Xr Arcore
components.detailsHtml:
Major features of 1.0.0:

  • ARCore for Jetpack XR is now stable! The ARCore for Jetpack XR library provides capabilities for blending digital content with the real world. This library includes motion tracking, persistent anchors, hit testing, plane identification with semantic labeling (for example, floor, walls, and tabletops), and Geospatial poses using Google's Visual Positioning System.
  • For more information, see our Developer Guide and API Reference.

components.name: Xr Arcore
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Introduced the SpatialAnnotation API for tracking 3D physical geometries and objects. Added SpatialAnnotationTrackingOptions and its corresponding builder pattern to configure spatial tracking via camera image buffers. (I918ce)
  • Introduced SpatialAnnotation and SpatialAnnotationTrackingMode to Jetpack XR ARCore, enabling developers to configure and track arbitrary bounded 3D quadrilateral geometries (Quad) targeted at physical real-world spatial environments. (I880e4)
  • Added TestSpatialAnnotation to allow programmatic simulation of spatial annotations in automated tests. (If2335)
  • Added geospatialPose, horizontalAccuracy, verticalAccuracy, and orientationYawAccuracy as new APIs to give more information in the Geospatial state. (If28f8)

Bug Fixes

  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Checked for max image count of 0 when configuring AugmentedImage, throwing UnsupportedOperationException instead of failing unexpectedly. I6ce439
  • Fix memory leaks and concurrency issues in AugmentedImageRenderer by properly tracking and cancelling rendering jobs, disposing of entities, and safely modifying the images collection. Ie70760

components.name: Xr Compose
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)
  • Renamed the halfLifeMs parameter of FollowMode.soft() to halfLifeMillis. (I39187)
  • Converted PitchLimits into an @JvmInline value class packing two floats into a Long to eliminate object allocations. (Id43c3)
  • Added new parameter for FollowMode.soft: halfLifeMs, startDelay, and startThresholds parameters. Removed parameter durationMs as it no longer needed as we transition from a smoothStep algorithm to an exponentialDecay algorithm. (If0140)
  • Remove the deprecated SpatialActivityPanel overload. Use the overload ofSpatialActivityPanel that accepts a SpatialActivityPanelController instead. (I5abc3)
  • Enable transitions between 3D and 2D Composable content within one Activity in FullSpaceMode. This change is gated by SpatialComposeFlags.isMainPanelResetOnSubspaceDisposeEnabled. (I4e237)
  • Exposed experimental Subspace overload taking a FollowTarget parameter to support following content. (Iec1a9)
  • Remove deprecated movable modifiers. Use the new movable modifier instead that accepts the new MovePolicy as a parameter. (Ib135d)
  • Remove deprecated DragPolicy. Use SubspaceModifier.movable() instead. (I108d4)
  • Deprecated stateless Slider and RangeSlider overloads in favor of their stateful versions. Renamed activeRangeStart and activeRangeEnd in RangeSliderState to startValue and endValue, deprecating older unpromoted and experimental Slider APIs with DeprecationLevel.HIDDEN. (If8995)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed RotateToLookAtUser by introducing poseInActivitySpace to ensure correct pose calculation for all subspace types, including those attached to anchors or users.Ica367b
  • Fix Constraints crash when Orbiter is attached to large panels (I8c4bf)
  • Fixed a bug in SubspaceLayoutNode where removeAll() caused unnecessary ArrayList allocations. Also fixed depth calculation performance. I34a10a
  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Improve kdocs related to AudioOutputProvider to highlight that it should not be re-used with multiple ExoPlayer instances (I6b18e)
  • Fix minor kdoc spelling and grammar issues (Id3ba6)

Known Issues

  • This version of androidx.xr.compose has a dependency on androidx.xr.scenecore:1.0.0-rc01, which has a known memory leak. In your build configuration, you may explicitly override the SceneCore dependency to version 1.0.0, which includes a fix for the memory leak.

components.name: Xr Glimmer
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • AlertDialog's text parameter is now optional and has moved to after title. (I0e0d4)
  • Introduce focusedBackgroundColor and focusedCheckedBackgroundColor for ToggleButton (Iab0ba)
  • Renamed AlertDialog's shape, contentColor, and contentPadding parameters (and the matching AlertDialogDefaults members) to containerShape, containerContentColor, and containerContentPadding, to clarify that they only apply to the dialog container, not the buttons. (I24f24)
  • Introduce focusedBackgroundColor and focusedCheckedBackgroundColor for IconToggleButton (Id5d8d)
  • Fixes an edge case bug with rendering certain rounded rectangle outlines in Modifier.border. ComposeFoundationFlags.isRoundedRectangleBorderRenderingFixEnabled can be used to disable this change if it causes issues. (I19141)

Bug Fixes

  • Modifier.border now supports rendering generic / polygon shapes with a runtime shader, when using the new border implementation. (I128ca)

components.name: Xr Projected
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Enabled battery state tests with ProjectedTestRule (I6f56d)
  • Added ProjectedActivityCompat.setActivityAsInputReceiver and clearActivityAsInputReceiver to allow apps to specify exactly which component should be relaunched and receive input focus when system-initiated focus shifts occur on displayless devices. (Id21e5)

Bug Fixes

  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Fixed an issue in isProjectedDeviceConnected where the host device context was not correctly created, leading to potential issues accessing system services.

components.name: Xr Runtime
components.detailsHtml:
Major features of 1.0.0:

  • Jetpack XR Runtime is now stable! The Jetpack XR Runtime library contains common classes, interfaces, and utilities used by the ARCore for Jetpack XR, SceneCore, and XR Compose libraries and their clients.
  • For more information, see our Developer Guide for Jetpack XR, as well as the XR Runtime API Reference.

components.name: Xr Runtime
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added dynamic mesh update APIs (MeshBuffer.createDynamic, MeshBuffer.updateVertexData, MeshBuffer.updateIndexData, and a dynamic CustomMesh.BuilderFromMeshData constructor) to support updating vertex and index data at runtime. (Ia1ecb)
  • Change Quad.createFromCorners to Quad.fromCorners and Quad.createAxisAligned to Quad.fromMinMax. (Idef53)
  • Libraries now target Kotlin 2.2 and require kotlinc 2.2 (I82396, b/498369605)
  • Add SPATIAL_API_V4 to SpatialApiVersions (I71e7a)

Bug Fixes

  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Session.create now returns the existing Session if one has already been created for the given Context, and throws an IllegalStateException if the existing Session was created with a different LifecycleOwner. (I9fcd7)
  • Removed Activity context leak in XrDevice. (I71996)
  • Fixed a bug where XrDevice lifecycle observers were incorrectly registered using lifecycleScope, which led to premature cancellation and potential context leaks during Activity teardown. The registration now correctly uses a persistent CoroutineScope linked to the main dispatcher. I6b2676b071870e4687cf2eb5718932f9df181c61

components.name: Xr Scenecore
components.detailsHtml:
Major features of 1.0.0:

  • Jetpack XR SceneCore is now stable! SceneCore lets you place and arrange 3D content, defined by entities, relative to each other and your environment. With SceneCore, you can create, place, and manipulate 2D panels and 3D models in virtual and mixed-reality scenes; specify spatial environments and spatial audio sources; and anchor virtual content to the real world.
  • For more information, see our Overview Page and API Reference.

components.name: Xr Scenecore
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added dynamic mesh update APIs (MeshBuffer.createDynamic, MeshBuffer.updateVertexData, MeshBuffer.updateIndexData, and a dynamic CustomMesh.BuilderFromMeshData constructor) to support updating vertex and index data at runtime. (Ia1ecb)
  • Added VertexLayout.getBufferIndex helper methods to easily retrieve the buffer index for a given VertexAttribute or VertexBufferLayout. (I1a9e3)
  • Made CustomMesh.bounds a var so the bounding box can be updated dynamically at runtime. (Ib0397)
  • Promoted glTF animation APIs (GltfAnimation, GltfModelEntity.getAnimations, and GltfModelEntity.stopAllAnimations) to public/stable while keeping GltfAnimation.loop setter as experimental, and GltfAnimationStartOptions and start(options) as experimental and deprecated. (Iacdae)
  • Added stopAllAnimations() to GltfModelEntity, made GltfAnimation.start() parameterless, added loop and speed properties to GltfAnimation, and deprecated GltfAnimationStartOptions, start(options), and seekTo(Duration). (I53105)
  • Updated GltfModelEntity APIs to document IllegalStateException (specifically Entity.DisposedException) when called on disposed entities. I65a76f

Bug Fixes

  • androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime dependency was updated to 2.10.0. This version is required for bundled lifecycle runtime lint checks to run with AGP version 9.5.0-alpha04 or later. (I99bfd, b/556807521)
  • Improve kdocs related to AudioOutputProvider to highlight that it should not be re-used with multiple ExoPlayer instances (I6b18e)
  • Removed unnecessary dependencies on impress from various XR modules. I84636c
